The RPC contract

The RPCs by which the UI, the Web and the Agent talk to tsugumid, generated from the doc comments of protocol/tsugumi.fbs.

  • Format: one message is one FlatBuffer (root Tsugumi.RPC.Message, file identifier TSG1). The WebSocket subprotocol is tsugumi.rpc.v1; on a Unix socket, a 4-byte length (little endian) is followed by the body.
  • Failure: any request may be answered with Failure.
  • Requests that change something: carry an op_id, and a resend with the same op_id is applied only once. If a response is lost, check with OperationGet.
  • The Agent's tools: made from the same schema (tsugumi.bfbs) (Features).

There are 41 requests.

Connection

RequestResponseDescription
SessionHelloHelloResulttoken is required on WebSocket. Project mismatch is permission_denied. Must be the first request, within 5 s of connecting. protocol is the newest version the client speaks and min_protocol the oldest (default: protocol); the server answers with the newest version both speak (HelloResult.protocol), or protocol_mismatch.

SessionHello

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
protocoluint32
client_idstringyes
expected_project_idstring
tokenstring
min_protocoluint32
languagestringThe client's language ("ja" or "en"; anything else is Japanese). What tsugumid writes into the project's git for the runs this connection starts (the commit message, the run's note) is in it.

Versions

RequestResponseDescription
VersionInitVersionResultMakes the project a git repository: a first commit of what is saved (a demo's history file becomes its versions). Nothing happens when it already is one.
VersionMarkVersionResultNames the current version: what is saved is committed (when it changed) and gets an annotated tag name with message.
VersionCheckoutSaveResultStarts from a version: what is saved now is committed, then the project's files become those of commit and the document is read again (like ProjectReload). Only while no run is active.
VersionGraphVersionGraph, newest first
VersionCanvasVersionCanvas: the Cards of a version and how they connect (a minimap)
VersionDiffVersionDiff: what a version changed from its first parent, in the text a summary is written fromOnly code and settings: never data files.
VersionSummaryVersionResultKeeps a client's summary of a version in the commit's own note (refs/notes/tsugumi-summary), replacing the one there.
